facets.reviewer_rationale: P8 accepts params plus an empty entry workflow; it does not exercise every listed declaration kind.
The selected Mix snippets contain statements only and use the last-result helper. Values do not independently assert implicit-workflow identity.
Count one plus the original contains predicate rejects this concrete top-level println/workflow mixture. P6 locations are source-specific internal checks.
No selected test includes a module and observes whether top-level statements run.
Typed workflow execution is outside this group; v2 is a selected environment obligation.
No selected runtime fixture enables typed workflows; no typing flag is added.
P8 can support params acceptance with typing disabled. No output-block case is selected. P7 entry-workflow rejection is source-only, not specified by this span.
The outgoing syntax and migration links remain unreviewed.
Collection values after helper normalization do not independently preserve the returned channel type; helper/observer equivalence remains pending.
Document inputs are strings. The first three M1 inputs are integers; these are distinct cases.
Original M1 rejects missing required values and c but permits duplicates and other extras. Exact complete multiset claims detect those losses under separate document/strengthened origins.
Membership, sorted equality and multiset equality accept permutations. This is comparator compatibility, not runtime proof of every schedule.
The complete mix.out has no final LF. Its illustrative order and terminal bytes are not an engine-output oracle.
The arity source exercises string aliases. Its status predicates do not assert identifier binding or staged filename contents.
Source counts 1, 2 and 1..* exercise valid examples. No arbitrary range domain is proved.
Valid-count zero exits cannot detect missing invalid-count enforcement. G-IN requires one existing file against declared count two and associated failure evidence.
No selected predicate compares name or stageAs behavior.
No selected env-input string/export observation exists.
The multiple-input-files link is not separately reviewed; G-IN supplies a single file.
Exact and wildcard output patterns feed matching path inputs. Exit status cannot establish their contents or all pattern rules.
Valid counts 1, 2 and 1..* are source examples; the predicates do not quantify every number/range.
G-OUT produces exactly one one.txt with declared count two. The observer must associate an output-count violation, not any nonzero exit.
Arity one must emit a file value before display. Original arity status checks cannot detect scalar/list confusion.
Arity 1..* with one produced file must emit a one-element file list. An identical printed basename is insufficient.
All selected shape contracts specify arity; no absent-arity mixed-shape behavior is observed.
No runtime default value is inferred. Input arity defaults and output followLinks defaults fall outside the frozen requirements.
The source supplies a valid String topic name. File comparisons do not prove Channel class identity or rejection of other name types.
Missing foo or bar version values changes final bytes. The case has one matching topic and does not test isolation from unmatched names.
Typed topic section and >> examples remain outside selected runtime work.
Original stdout topic outputs exercise the legacy topic option. The document path-file form is a distinct example.
unique and sorted collectFile transform raw emissions. Exact final bytes detect missing distinct versions but cannot prove every sent item, multiplicity or original channel order.
Historical version availability and preview-flag conditions are frozen documentation, not runtime tests.
No consumer-emitter feedback cycle is selected.
The typed topic-output reference remains unreviewed.
